# #194 — 503 'Too many active sessions' recurred on initialize (2026-06-21) despite #17 — verify session-cap holds under fleet load

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-22T02:14:58Z
Updated: 2026-06-22T20:45:01Z
Closed: 2026-06-22T20:45:01Z

## Summary
OpenBrain returned `HTTP 503: {"error": "Too many active sessions"}` on `initialize`, causing a Hermes memory provider to fail to come up and fall back to local spool. This recurred on 2026-06-21 despite #17 (leaked sessions exhaust MAX_SESSIONS) being closed — worth confirming the session-cap/leak fix holds under live fleet load.

## Evidence (Bilby gateway, 2026-06-21)
`~/.hermes/logs/errors.log`:
```
2026-06-21 20:05:45 ERROR _hermes_user_memory.openbrain: Open Brain required contract validation
  failed: OpenBrain HTTP 503: context=initialize body={"error": "Too many active sessions"}
2026-06-21 20:05:45 WARNING agent.memory_manager: Memory provider 'openbrain' initialize failed:
  Open Brain required contract validation failed
```

## Why this matters
- A 503 on initialize takes the whole OB memory provider offline for that agent until restart/retry → silent degradation to local spool.
- #17 was supposed to fix leaked sessions exhausting MAX_SESSIONS; this 503 suggests either the cap is too low for the fleet (Skippy + Bilby + Nagatha + Codex + Claude clients) or sessions are still leaking.

## Asks
1. Confirm whether sessions are leaking again (active-session count vs MAX_SESSIONS at the time) or the cap is simply undersized for current client count.
2. Consider: per-client session reuse, idle-session reaping, or returning 429+Retry-After instead of a hard 503 so clients can back off (pairs with rtech-hermes #156).

## Related
